import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# --- paths ---
FEAT = "/Users/maxchalekson/Projects/NICO-Research/NICO_human-gemini/facilitator-identification/3-reconsolidating-features-temporal/ALL_person_year_segment_CONSOLIDATED_WITH_OUTCOMES.csv"

# --- load ---
df = pd.read_csv(FEAT)

# keep only the three thirds we care about
df = df[df["segment"].isin(["first","middle","last"])].copy()

# tidy types
df["conference"] = df["conference"].astype(str)
if "role_facilitator" in df.columns:
    df["role_facilitator"] = pd.to_numeric(df["role_facilitator"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)

# feature list (scores; adjust if you switch to counts)
features = [
    "ann_knowledge_sharing_score",
    "ann_evaluation_practices_score",
    "ann_idea_management_score",
    "ann_coordination_and_decision_practices_score",
    "ann_information_seeking_score",
    "ann_relational_climate_score",
    "ann_participation_dynamics_score",
    "ann_integration_practices_score",
    # include 'ann_none_score' if you want
]

# --- pivot to person-level wide: one row per person x conference x year ---
# this creates columns like ann_knowledge_sharing_score_first/middle/last
wide_feats = []
for col in features + ["p_speaking_duration_sec"]:
    tmp = df.pivot_table(index=["person_name","conference","year"],
                         columns="segment",
                         values=col,
                         aggfunc="sum")
    tmp.columns = [f"{col}_{c}" for c in tmp.columns]
    wide_feats.append(tmp)

wide = pd.concat(wide_feats, axis=1).reset_index()

# bring role_facilitator (if present) — take max across thirds for the year
if "role_facilitator" in df.columns:
    rf = (df.groupby(["person_name","conference","year"], as_index=False)["role_facilitator"]
            .max())
    wide = wide.merge(rf, on=["person_name","conference","year"], how="left")

# add a total speaking-time control (optional but handy)
wide["speaking_total"] = wide[[c for c in wide.columns if c.startswith("p_speaking_duration_sec_")]].sum(axis=1)

# --- run per-feature predictive regressions ---
results = []   # collect summaries per feature

for f in features:
    # ensure the columns exist after pivot
    cols_needed = [f"{f}_first", f"{f}_middle", f"{f}_last",
                   "p_speaking_duration_sec_first", "speaking_total", "conference"]
    for c in cols_needed:
        if c not in wide.columns:
            wide[c] = np.nan

    # modeling dataset
    d = wide.copy()

    # simple imputations to avoid dropping too much; you can also dropna if preferred
    d[[f"{f}_first", f"{f}_middle", f"{f}_last"]] = d[[f"{f}_first", f"{f}_middle", f"{f}_last"]].fillna(0)
    d["p_speaking_duration_sec_first"] = d["p_speaking_duration_sec_first"].fillna(0)
    d["speaking_total"] = d["speaking_total"].fillna(0)

    # build formula with facilitator interaction if available
    if "role_facilitator" in d.columns:
        # middle ~ first (+ interaction) + controls
        fm_mid = (f"{f}_middle ~ {f}_first"
                  f" + role_facilitator"
                  f" + {f}_first:role_facilitator"
                  f" + p_speaking_duration_sec_first"
                  f" + C(conference)")
        m_mid = smf.ols(fm_mid, data=d).fit(cov_type="HC3")

        # last ~ first (+ interaction) + controls
        fm_last = (f"{f}_last ~ {f}_first"
                   f" + role_facilitator"
                   f" + {f}_first:role_facilitator"
                   f" + p_speaking_duration_sec_first"
                   f" + C(conference)")
        m_last = smf.ols(fm_last, data=d).fit(cov_type="HC3")

        # grab the interaction p-values if present
        p_int_mid  = m_mid.pvalues.get(f"{f}_first:role_facilitator", np.nan)
        p_int_last = m_last.pvalues.get(f"{f}_first:role_facilitator", np.nan)

        results.append({
            "feature": f,
            "R2_middle_from_first": m_mid.rsquared,
            "R2_last_from_first": m_last.rsquared,
            "p_interaction_middle": p_int_mid,
            "p_interaction_last": p_int_last,
            "n": int(m_mid.nobs)
        })
    else:
        # no facilitator column -> run without the interaction
        fm_mid  = f"{f}_middle ~ {f}_first + p_speaking_duration_sec_first + C(conference)"
        fm_last = f"{f}_last   ~ {f}_first + p_speaking_duration_sec_first + C(conference)"
        m_mid   = smf.ols(fm_mid, data=d).fit(cov_type="HC3")
        m_last  = smf.ols(fm_last, data=d).fit(cov_type="HC3")
        results.append({
            "feature": f,
            "R2_middle_from_first": m_mid.rsquared,
            "R2_last_from_first": m_last.rsquared,
            "p_interaction_middle": np.nan,
            "p_interaction_last": np.nan,
            "n": int(m_mid.nobs)
        })

res_df = pd.DataFrame(results).sort_values("R2_middle_from_first", ascending=False)
print("\n[Predictive power: middle/last from first] (higher R² = stronger carryover)")
print(res_df.to_string(index=False, float_format=lambda x: f"{x:.3f}"))

# Optional: save it next to your outputs
out_csv = "/Users/maxchalekson/Projects/NICO-Research/NICO_human-gemini/facilitator-identification/3-reconsolidating-features-temporal/regression-model-output/predict_middle_last_from_first.csv"
res_df.to_csv(out_csv, index=False)
print(f"\n[OK] wrote {out_csv}")

# ================================================================
# SLIDE FIGURE FACTORY — person-level temporal analysis (polished+complete)
# ================================================================

import warnings, textwrap, re
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import statsmodels.api as sm
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
sns.set_context("talk")

# ---------- PATHS ----------
BASE   = Path("/Users/maxchalekson/Projects/NICO-Research/NICO_human-gemini/facilitator-identification/3-reconsolidating-features-temporal")
FEAT   = BASE / "ALL_person_year_segment_CONSOLIDATED_WITH_OUTCOMES.csv"
FIGDIR = BASE / "figures"
REGDIR = BASE / "regression-model-output"
FIGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
REGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# ---------- CONFIG ----------
SEG_ORDER          = ["first","middle","last"]
PERSON_SCOPE       = "across_all"   # "per_year" or "across_all"
DESC_AGG           = "sum"          # "sum" or "mean"
ALPHA_P            = 0.05
MAX_PANELS_PER_PNG = 6

REG_FEATURES = [
    "ann_knowledge_sharing_score",
    "ann_evaluation_practices_score",
    "ann_idea_management_score",
    "ann_coordination_and_decision_practices_score",
    "ann_information_seeking_score",
    "ann_relational_climate_score",
    "ann_participation_dynamics_score",
    "ann_integration_practices_score",
]

ALIASES = {
    "ann_knowledge_sharing": "Knowledge sharing",
    "ann_evaluation_practices": "Evaluation practices",
    "ann_idea_management": "Idea management",
    "ann_coordination_and_decision_practices": "Coordination & decision",
    "ann_information_seeking": "Information seeking",
    "ann_relational_climate": "Relational climate",
    "ann_participation_dynamics": "Participation dynamics",
    "ann_integration_practices": "Integration practices",
    "ann_none": "None",
}

def nice(col: str) -> str:
    base = col.replace("ann_","").replace("_score","").replace("_count","")
    return ALIASES.get(f"ann_{base}", base.replace("_"," ").title())

def wrap(s, w=46):
    import textwrap as tw
    return "\n".join(tw.wrap(str(s), width=w))

# ---------- LOAD ----------
df = pd.read_csv(FEAT)
df = df[df["segment"].isin(SEG_ORDER)].copy()
df["segment"] = pd.Categorical(df["segment"], categories=SEG_ORDER, ordered=True)
df["conference"] = df["conference"].astype(str)

# If a stable person_id exists, use it; else fall back to person_name
PERSON_ID_COL = "person_id" if "person_id" in df.columns else "person_name"
df[PERSON_ID_COL] = df[PERSON_ID_COL].astype(str)

has_fac    = "role_facilitator"  in df.columns
has_teams  = "num_teams"         in df.columns
has_funded = "num_funded_teams"  in df.columns

if has_fac:
    df["role_facilitator"] = pd.to_numeric(df["role_facilitator"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)

# handy group flags
df["any_team"]   = (df.get("num_teams", 0).fillna(0) > 0).astype(int)
df["any_funded"] = (df.get("num_funded_teams", 0).fillna(0) > 0).astype(int)

# prefer counts for descriptives if available
CANDIDATE_COUNTS = [f.replace("_score","_count") for f in REG_FEATURES]
DESC_FEATURES = [c for c in CANDIDATE_COUNTS if c in df.columns]
if not DESC_FEATURES:
    DESC_FEATURES = REG_FEATURES[:]  # fallback to scores

# ---------- PERSON KEYS ----------
# per_year => person×conference×year; across_all => person only
PERSON_KEYS = [PERSON_ID_COL] if PERSON_SCOPE == "across_all" else [PERSON_ID_COL, "conference", "year"]

# ---------- helper: add C(conference) only if present ----------
def _conf_term(df_like):
    return " + C(conference)" if "conference" in df_like.columns else ""

# ---------- Helper: WIDE table used by prediction models ----------
def to_wide(dfin: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    cols = REG_FEATURES + ["p_speaking_duration_sec"]
    blocks = []
    for col in cols:
        pt = dfin.pivot_table(index=PERSON_KEYS, columns="segment", values=col, aggfunc="sum")
        pt.columns = [f"{col}_{c}" for c in pt.columns]
        blocks.append(pt)
    wide = pd.concat(blocks, axis=1).reset_index()

    if has_fac:
        rf = dfin.groupby(PERSON_KEYS, as_index=False)["role_facilitator"].max()
        wide = wide.merge(rf, on=PERSON_KEYS, how="left")
        wide["role_facilitator"] = wide["role_facilitator"].fillna(0).astype(int)

    for flag, col in [("any_team","num_teams"), ("any_funded","num_funded_teams")]:
        if col in dfin.columns:
            tmp = dfin.groupby(PERSON_KEYS, as_index=False)[col].sum()
            tmp[flag] = (tmp[col] > 0).astype(int)
            wide = wide.merge(tmp[PERSON_KEYS + [flag]], on=PERSON_KEYS, how="left")
        else:
            wide[flag] = 0

    speak_cols = [c for c in wide.columns if c.startswith("p_speaking_duration_sec_")]
    wide["speaking_total"] = wide[speak_cols].sum(axis=1).fillna(0) if speak_cols else 0.0
    wide["speaking_first"] = wide.get("p_speaking_duration_sec_first", pd.Series(0, index=wide.index)).fillna(0)
    return wide

wide = to_wide(df)

# ---------- SLIDE A: outcome distributions ----------
def make_outcome_distributions():
    if not (has_teams or has_funded): return
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2 if has_teams and has_funded else 1, figsize=(14, 5))
    if not isinstance(axes, np.ndarray): axes = np.array([axes])

    def one(ax, col):
        if col not in df.columns:
            ax.axis("off"); return
        z = (df[col].fillna(0) == 0).mean()
        ax.hist(df[col].fillna(0), bins=range(int(df[col].max())+2))
        ax.set_title(f"{col} (zeros={z:.1%})")
        ax.set_xlabel(col); ax.set_ylabel("Count")

    if has_teams:   one(axes[0], "num_teams")
    if has_funded:  one(axes[1 if has_teams else 0], "num_funded_teams")

    fig.suptitle("Outcome distributions (check for zero-inflation)")
    fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(FIGDIR/"outcome_distributions.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close(fig)

# ---------- SLIDE 1: schematic ----------
def make_schematic():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 3.2))
    ax.axis("off"); ax.set_xlim(0, 10); ax.set_ylim(0, 3)
    ax.hlines(1.5, 0.7, 9.3, linewidth=2, color="black")
    for x,lbl in zip([2.5,5.0,7.5], SEG_ORDER):
        ax.vlines(x, 1.2, 1.8, color="gray", linestyle="--", linewidth=1)
        ax.text(x, 2.0, lbl, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=12)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
    for x in sorted(rng.uniform(1.0,9.0,18)):
        ax.scatter([x],[1.5 + rng.normal(0,0.08)], s=60, ec="black", fc="white", zorder=3)
    ax.text(0.7, 2.55, "Person-level aggregation across sessions", fontsize=13, weight="bold")
    scope_note = "across all conferences when selected" if PERSON_SCOPE=="across_all" else "in the year"
    ax.text(0.7, 0.35, wrap(
        f"Each dot = utterance with code scores → aggregated per person × temporal third "
        f"(first/middle/last), then summed within session and summed across sessions {scope_note}."
    ), fontsize=10)
    fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(FIGDIR/"schematic_person_aggregation.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close(fig)

# ---------- SLIDE 2: features glossary ----------
def make_features_glossary():
    lines = [f"• {nice(f)} — sum of per-utterance scores per person×third; aggregated to person–level ({PERSON_SCOPE})"
             for f in REG_FEATURES]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.6, 6.0))
    ax.axis("off")
    ax.text(0.02, 0.98, "Features (person-level, temporal):\n\n" + "\n".join(lines),
            ha="left", va="top", fontsize=12)
    fig.savefig(FIGDIR/"features_glossary.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close(fig)

# ---------- SLIDE 3: temporal correlations ----------
def make_temporal_correlation_grid():
    use_feats = DESC_FEATURES  # counts if present, else scores

    W_blocks = []
    for col in use_feats:
        pt = df.pivot_table(index=PERSON_KEYS, columns="segment", values=col, aggfunc="sum")
        pt.columns = [f"{col}_{c}" for c in pt.columns]
        W_blocks.append(pt)
    W = pd.concat(W_blocks, axis=1)

    pages = [use_feats[i:i+MAX_PANELS_PER_PNG] for i in range(0, len(use_feats), MAX_PANELS_PER_PNG)]
    tag = "counts" if use_feats != REG_FEATURES else "scores"

    for pi, feats in enumerate(pages, start=1):
        rows, cols = 2, 3
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(rows, cols, figsize=(12, 7), constrained_layout=True)
        axes = np.asarray(axes).ravel()

        for ax, f in zip(axes, feats):
            sub = W[[f"{f}_first", f"{f}_middle", f"{f}_last"]].fillna(0)
            mat = sub.corr()
            mat.index = ["first","middle","last"]; mat.columns = ["first","middle","last"]
            sns.heatmap(mat, annot=True, cmap="Blues", cbar=False, ax=ax, fmt=".2f", vmin=0, vmax=1,
                        annot_kws={"fontsize":9})
            ax.set_xlabel(""); ax.set_ylabel(""); ax.set_title(nice(f), fontsize=12)

        for j in range(len(feats), len(axes)): axes[j].axis("off")

        fig.suptitle(f"Within-person temporal correlations (first/middle/last) — {tag} (page {pi})", fontsize=14)
        out = FIGDIR / (f"temporal_correlation_grid_p{pi}.png" if len(pages) > 1
                        else "temporal_correlation_grid.png")
        fig.savefig(out, dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight", pil_kwargs={"compress_level": 1})
        plt.close(fig)

# ---------- SLIDE 3b: descriptive volume by third ----------
def make_descriptive_volume_panel():
    feats = DESC_FEATURES
    tmp = df.copy()
    tmp["segment"] = pd.Categorical(tmp["segment"], categories=SEG_ORDER, ordered=True)

    if DESC_AGG == "sum":
        g = (tmp[["segment"] + feats]
             .groupby("segment", as_index=False)
             .sum(numeric_only=True))
        ylab = "Sum per person-scope"
    else:
        g = (tmp[["segment"] + feats]
             .groupby("segment", as_index=False)
             .mean(numeric_only=True))
        ylab = "Mean per person-scope"

    means = g.melt(id_vars="segment", var_name="feature", value_name="value")
    means["feature_nice"] = means["feature"].map(nice)

    plt.figure(figsize=(11.5, 6))
    sns.lineplot(data=means, x="segment", y="value", hue="feature_nice", marker="o", linewidth=2)
    title_tag = "counts" if "count" in feats[0] else "scores"
    plt.title(f"Descriptive volume by temporal third — {title_tag}")
    plt.xlabel("Temporal third"); plt.ylabel(ylab)
    plt.legend(loc="center left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.5), frameon=False, ncol=1, title=None)
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(FIGDIR/"descriptive_volume_by_third.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close()

# ---------- SLIDE 4/5: OLS sweeps ----------
def fit_ols_per_segment(y_col: str, out_png: str):
    rows = []
    for seg in SEG_ORDER:
        keep = PERSON_KEYS + ["segment", y_col, "p_speaking_duration_sec"] + REG_FEATURES
        dseg = df[df["segment"]==seg][keep].dropna(subset=[y_col]).copy()
        if dseg.empty:
            continue
        conf = _conf_term(dseg)
        fml = f"{y_col} ~ " + " + ".join(REG_FEATURES) + " + p_speaking_duration_sec" + conf

        # cluster-robust by person, fallback HC3
        cluster = dseg[PERSON_ID_COL] if PERSON_ID_COL in dseg.columns else None
        if cluster is not None:
            m = smf.ols(fml, data=dseg).fit(cov_type="cluster", cov_kwds={"groups": cluster})
        else:
            m = smf.ols(fml, data=dseg).fit(cov_type="HC3")

        for feat in REG_FEATURES:
            if feat in m.params.index:
                rows.append({
                    "outcome": y_col, "segment": seg, "feature": feat,
                    "coef": float(m.params[feat]), "se": float(m.bse[feat]),
                    "p": float(m.pvalues[feat]), "r2": float(m.rsquared), "n": int(m.nobs)
                })

    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    tab = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    tab.to_csv(REGDIR / f"models_ols_by_segment_{y_col}.csv", index=False)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.8, 6))
    top = (tab.groupby("feature")["coef"].apply(lambda s: s.abs().mean())
           .sort_values(ascending=False).head(8)).index.tolist()

    for feat in top:
        sub = tab[tab["feature"]==feat].copy()
        sub["seg_idx"] = sub["segment"].map({k:i for i,k in enumerate(SEG_ORDER)})
        sub = sub.sort_values("seg_idx")
        ax.plot(sub["segment"], sub["coef"], linewidth=1.6, label=nice(feat), alpha=0.9)
        for _, r in sub.iterrows():
            sig = r["p"] < ALPHA_P
            ax.errorbar([r["segment"]], [r["coef"]], yerr=[1.96*r["se"]],
                        fmt="o", mec="black", mfc=("C0" if sig else "white"),
                        mew=1, capsize=0, alpha=1.0 if sig else 0.9)

    ax.axhline(0, color="black", lw=1)
    ax.set_title(f"OLS sweep by temporal third — {y_col}\n(Plot shows MODEL COEFFICIENTS ±95% CI)")
    ax.set_xlabel("Temporal third"); ax.set_ylabel("Coefficient (±95% CI)")
    ax.legend(loc="center left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.5), fontsize=9, frameon=False, title=None)
    fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(FIGDIR / out_png, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close(fig)
    return tab

# ---------- SLIDE 5b: Negative binomial for funded counts ----------
def fit_negbin_num_funded():
    if not has_funded: return
    d = df.dropna(subset=["num_funded_teams"]).copy()
    conf = _conf_term(d)
    fml = (
        "num_funded_teams ~ "
        + " + ".join(REG_FEATURES)
        + " + p_speaking_duration_sec"
        + conf
        + " + C(segment)"
    )
    m = smf.glm(fml, data=d, family=sm.families.NegativeBinomial()).fit()
    pd.DataFrame({"term": m.params.index, "coef": m.params.values,
                  "se": m.bse.values, "p": m.pvalues.values}) \
      .to_csv(REGDIR/"model_negbin_num_funded_teams.csv", index=False)

# ---------- SLIDE 6: Logistic (facilitator) ----------
def pretty_term(t: str) -> str:
    m = re.match(r'^(ann_.+?)_score:C\(segment\)\[T\.(first|middle|last)\]$', t)
    if m: return f"{nice(m.group(1))} × {m.group(2)}"
    if t.startswith("C(segment)[T."):
        return t.replace("C(segment)[T.","segment = ").replace("]","")
    return t

def fit_logit_facilitator():
    if not has_fac: return pd.DataFrame()
    d = df.dropna(subset=["role_facilitator"]).copy()
    conf = _conf_term(d)
    fml = (
        "role_facilitator ~ ("
        + " + ".join(REG_FEATURES)
        + ") * C(segment) + p_speaking_duration_sec"
        + conf
    )
    m = smf.logit(fml, data=d).fit(disp=0)
    tab = pd.DataFrame({"term": m.params.index, "coef": m.params.values,
                        "se": m.bse.values, "p": m.pvalues.values})
    tab.to_csv(REGDIR / "models_logit_facilitator_interactions.csv", index=False)

    take = tab[tab["term"].str.contains(r"C\(segment\)\[T\.", regex=True)].copy()
    if take.empty:
        print("[LOGIT] No segment-interaction terms found (skipping plot)."); return tab
    take["abscoef"] = take["coef"].abs()
    take = take.sort_values("abscoef", ascending=False).head(12)
    take["pretty"] = take["term"].apply(pretty_term)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 6))
    y = np.arange(len(take))[::-1]
    ax.errorbar(take["coef"], y, xerr=1.96*take["se"], fmt="o", capsize=3)
    ax.axvline(0, color="black", lw=1)
    ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([wrap(t) for t in take["pretty"]])
    ax.set_xlabel("Log-odds (coef ±95% CI)")
    ax.set_title("Logistic regression — facilitator × segment interactions")
    fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(FIGDIR/"logit_facilitator_interactions.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close(fig)
    return tab

# ---------- SLIDE 7: Begin→middle/last prediction + group comparisons ----------
def temporal_prediction_from_first():
    rows = []
    groups = {
        "all": slice(None),
        "facilitator": (wide.get("role_facilitator", 0) == 1),
        "non_facilitator": (wide.get("role_facilitator", 0) == 0),
        "any_team": (wide.get("any_team", 0) == 1),
        "no_team": (wide.get("any_team", 0) == 0),
        "any_funded": (wide.get("any_funded", 0) == 1),
        "no_funded": (wide.get("any_funded", 0) == 0),
    }
    for gname, gmask in groups.items():
        dG = wide[gmask].copy() if isinstance(gmask, pd.Series) else wide.copy()
        for f in REG_FEATURES:
            for col in [f"{f}_first", f"{f}_middle", f"{f}_last"]:
                if col not in dG.columns: dG[col] = 0.0
            dG["speaking_first"] = pd.to_numeric(dG["speaking_first"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
            fm_mid  = f"{f}_middle ~ {f}_first + speaking_first"
            fm_last = f"{f}_last   ~ {f}_first + speaking_first"
            m_mid  = smf.ols(fm_mid,  data=dG).fit(cov_type="HC3")
            m_last = smf.ols(fm_last, data=dG).fit(cov_type="HC3")
            rows.append({"group": gname, "feature": f,
                         "R2_middle_from_first": m_mid.rsquared,
                         "R2_last_from_first":   m_last.rsquared,
                         "n": int(m_mid.nobs)})
    res = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    res.to_csv(REGDIR/"predict_middle_last_from_first_by_group.csv", index=False)

    # Main bar (ALL)
    base = res[res["group"]=="all"].copy().sort_values("R2_last_from_first", ascending=False)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 6))
    plot = base.copy(); plot["Feature"] = plot["feature"].map(nice)
    plot = plot.set_index("Feature")[["R2_middle_from_first","R2_last_from_first"]]
    plot.plot(kind="bar", ax=ax)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1); ax.set_ylabel("R²")
    scope_txt = "across-all person scope" if PERSON_SCOPE=="across_all" else "per-year person scope"
    ax.set_title(f"Temporal prediction: beginning → middle/last (person-level, {scope_txt})")
    plt.xticks(rotation=30, ha="right"); fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(FIGDIR/"temporal_prediction_bar.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close(fig)

    # Comparison helpers
    def comp_plot(groups_pair, fname, title_suffix):
        comp = res[res["group"].isin(groups_pair)].copy()
        if comp.empty: return
        comp["Feature"] = comp["feature"].map(nice)
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11.5, 5.2))
        sns.barplot(data=comp, x="Feature", y="R2_last_from_first", hue="group", ax=ax)
        ax.set_ylim(0, 1); ax.set_ylabel("R² (last ~ first)"); ax.set_xlabel("")
        ax.set_title(f"Prediction power comparison: {title_suffix}")
        plt.xticks(rotation=30, ha="right"); plt.tight_layout()
        plt.savefig(FIGDIR/fname, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close(fig)

    comp_plot(["facilitator","non_facilitator"], "temporal_prediction_fac_vs_nonfac.png",
              "facilitators vs non-facilitators")
    comp_plot(["any_team","no_team"], "temporal_prediction_anyteam_vs_noteam.png",
              "any team vs no team")
    comp_plot(["any_funded","no_funded"], "temporal_prediction_anyfunded_vs_nofunded.png",
              "any funded vs none")

# ---------- SLIDE 9: findings card ----------
def make_findings_card():
    lines = [
        "Findings (person-level, temporal thirds)",
        "",
        "• Early behaviors predict later behaviors strongly (R²≈0.4–0.7).",
        "• OLS sweeps (MODEL COEFFICIENTS ±95% CI) show how timing relates to outcomes.",
        "  Descriptive panel shows raw volume by third (counts if available).",
        "• Funded teams: Relational climate & Information seeking stand out most.",
        "• Facilitators: timing interactions appear for climate/coordination signals.",
        "• In OLS sweeps, filled markers denote p<.05 (hollow = n.s.).",
        f"• Prediction scope shown here: {PERSON_SCOPE} (toggle in code).",
    ]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.8, 5.2)); ax.axis("off")
    ax.text(0.02, 0.95, "\n".join(lines), ha="left", va="top", fontsize=12)
    fig.savefig(FIGDIR/"findings_text_card.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close(fig)

# ---------------- RUN ALL ----------------
print("[A] outcomes");                        make_outcome_distributions()
print("[1] schematic");                       make_schematic()
print("[2] glossary");                        make_features_glossary()

print("[5] OLS num_funded");                  fit_ols_per_segment("num_funded_teams", "ols_sweep_num_funded_teams.png") if has_funded else None

# ================================================================
# EARLY → ROLE PREDICTION (first-third behaviors predicting roles)

# ---- Imports (safe to re-import) ----
from typing import List, Tuple
from pathlib import Path  # ensure Path is defined before use
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# ---- Load data (self-contained) ----
BASE   = Path("/Users/maxchalekson/Projects/NICO-Research/NICO_human-gemini/facilitator-identification/3-reconsolidating-features-temporal")
FEAT   = BASE / "ALL_person_year_segment_CONSOLIDATED_WITH_OUTCOMES.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(FEAT)
df = df[df["segment"].isin(["first","middle","last"])].copy()
df["segment"] = pd.Categorical(df["segment"], categories=["first","middle","last"], ordered=True)
df["conference"] = df["conference"].astype(str)
assert 'df' in globals(), "Please run your data loading cell first to define `df`."

# ---- Fallbacks for globals (only used if your pipeline didn't set them) ----
if 'REG_FEATURES' not in globals():
    REG_FEATURES = [
        "ann_knowledge_sharing_score",
        "ann_evaluation_practices_score",
        "ann_idea_management_score",
        "ann_coordination_and_decision_practices_score",
        "ann_information_seeking_score",
        "ann_relational_climate_score",
        "ann_participation_dynamics_score",
        "ann_integration_practices_score",
    ]

if 'ALIASES' not in globals():
    ALIASES = {
        "ann_knowledge_sharing": "Knowledge sharing",
        "ann_evaluation_practices": "Evaluation practices",
        "ann_idea_management": "Idea management",
        "ann_coordination_and_decision_practices": "Coordination & decision",
        "ann_information_seeking": "Information seeking",
        "ann_relational_climate": "Relational climate",
        "ann_participation_dynamics": "Participation dynamics",
        "ann_integration_practices": "Integration practices",
        "ann_none": "None",
    }

def _nice_first_label(term: str) -> str:
    if term == "speaking_first":
        return "Speaking time (first)"
    if term.endswith("_first"):
        base = term.replace("_first","").replace("_score","").replace("ann_","")
        human = ALIASES.get("ann_" + base, base.replace("_", " ").title())
        return f"{human} (first)"
    return term

# PERSON_KEYS: use your pipeline's if present; else per-year default
if 'PERSON_KEYS' not in globals():
    PERSON_KEYS = ["person_id" if "person_id" in df.columns else "person_name", "conference", "year"]

# Output directories (create if missing)
if 'FIGDIR' not in globals():
    FIGDIR = Path("./figures"); FIGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
if 'REGDIR' not in globals():
    REGDIR = Path("./regression-model-output"); REGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# ---- Wide builder (with observed=False to silence pandas FutureWarning) ----
if 'to_wide' not in globals():
    def to_wide(dfin: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        cols = REG_FEATURES + ["p_speaking_duration_sec"]
        blocks = []
        for col in cols:
            pt = dfin.pivot_table(
                index=PERSON_KEYS, columns="segment", values=col,
                aggfunc="sum", observed=False   # <-- silence FutureWarning
            )
            pt.columns = [f"{col}_{c}" for c in pt.columns]
            blocks.append(pt)
        wide_ = pd.concat(blocks, axis=1).reset_index()

        # speaking_first control
        wide_["speaking_first"] = wide_.get(
            "p_speaking_duration_sec_first", pd.Series(0, index=wide_.index)
        ).fillna(0)

        # role + group flags if present in df
        if "role_facilitator" in dfin.columns:
            rf = dfin.groupby(PERSON_KEYS, as_index=False)["role_facilitator"].max()
            wide_ = wide_.merge(rf, on=PERSON_KEYS, how="left")
            wide_["role_facilitator"] = pd.to_numeric(
                wide_["role_facilitator"], errors="coerce"
            ).fillna(0).astype(int)

        for flag, col in [("any_team","num_teams"), ("any_funded","num_funded_teams")]:
            if col in dfin.columns:
                tmp = dfin.groupby(PERSON_KEYS, as_index=False)[col].sum()
                tmp[flag] = (tmp[col] > 0).astype(int)
                wide_ = wide_.merge(tmp[PERSON_KEYS + [flag]], on=PERSON_KEYS, how="left")
            else:
                wide_[flag] = 0

        return wide_

if 'wide' not in globals():
    wide = to_wide(df)

# include C(conference) only if conference is part of PERSON_KEYS (per-year scope)
def _has_conference_fe_in_scope() -> bool:
    return "conference" in PERSON_KEYS

def _first_cols(feats: List[str]) -> List[str]:
    return [f"{f}_first" for f in feats]

# ---------- Prep first→role dataset ----------
def _build_first_df() -> pd.DataFrame:
    keep = []
    for y in ["role_facilitator", "any_team", "any_funded"]:
        if y in wide.columns:
            keep.append(y)
    keep += [c for c in _first_cols(REG_FEATURES) if c in wide.columns]
    if "speaking_first" in wide.columns:
        keep.append("speaking_first")
    keep += [c for c in PERSON_KEYS if c in wide.columns]

    dF = wide[keep].copy()
    # outcomes to int
    for y in ["role_facilitator","any_team","any_funded"]:
        if y in dF.columns:
            dF[y] = pd.to_numeric(dF[y], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
    # predictors numeric
    for c in _first_cols(REG_FEATURES) + ["speaking_first"]:
        if c in dF.columns:
            dF[c] = pd.to_numeric(dF[c], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
    return dF

# ---------- Fit one logistic model ----------
def _fit_logit_first2role(dfR: pd.DataFrame, outcome: str):
    X_cols = [c for c in _first_cols(REG_FEATURES) if c in dfR.columns]
    if (outcome not in dfR.columns) or (len(X_cols) == 0):
        print(f"[first→role] Skipping {outcome}: predictors or outcome missing.")
        return pd.DataFrame(), None

    rhs_terms = X_cols + (["speaking_first"] if "speaking_first" in dfR.columns else [])
    rhs = " + ".join(rhs_terms)
    if _has_conference_fe_in_scope():
        rhs += " + C(conference)"

    fml = f"{outcome} ~ {rhs}"
    m = smf.logit(fml, data=dfR).fit(disp=0, maxiter=200)

    tab = pd.DataFrame({
        "term": m.params.index,
        "coef": m.params.values,
        "se":   m.bse.values,
        "p":    m.pvalues.values
    })
    # odds ratios + 95% CI
    tab["or"]   = np.exp(tab["coef"])
    tab["lo95"] = np.exp(tab["coef"] - 1.96*tab["se"])
    tab["hi95"] = np.exp(tab["coef"] + 1.96*tab["se"])
    tab.to_csv(REGDIR / f"logit_first2role_{outcome}.csv", index=False)
    return tab, m

# ---------- Plot (odds ratios) ----------
def _plot_logit_first2role(tab: pd.DataFrame, outcome: str):
    if tab is None or tab.empty:
        return
    keep_mask = tab["term"].str.endswith("_first") | (tab["term"] == "speaking_first")
    take = tab[keep_mask].copy()
    if take.empty:
        print(f"[first→role] No first-third rows to plot for {outcome}."); return

    take = take.sort_values("coef", key=lambda s: s.abs(), ascending=False).head(12)
    take = take.sort_values("or")

    y = np.arange(len(take))
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.8, 6))
    ax.errorbar(
        take["or"], y,
        xerr=[take["or"] - take["lo95"], take["hi95"] - take["or"]],
        fmt="o", capsize=3
    )
    ax.axvline(1.0, color="black", lw=1)  # OR=1 baseline
    ax.set_yticks(y)
    ax.set_yticklabels([_nice_first_label(t) for t in take["term"]])
    title_map = {"role_facilitator":"Facilitator (1/0)", "any_team":"Any team (1/0)", "any_funded":"Any funded (1/0)"}
    ax.set_xlabel("Odds ratio (first-third predictors, ±95% CI)")
    ax.set_title(f"Beginning (first-third) behaviors → {title_map.get(outcome, outcome)}")
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(FIGDIR / f"logit_first2role_{outcome}.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)

# ---------- Runner ----------
def run_first_to_role_models():
    dfR = _build_first_df()
    outcomes = [y for y in ["role_facilitator","any_team","any_funded"] if y in dfR.columns]
    for y in outcomes:
        print(f"[8] First→role logistic for: {y}")
        tab, m = _fit_logit_first2role(dfR, y)
        if tab is not None and not tab.empty:
            _plot_logit_first2role(tab, y)
            # optional: save text summary
            try:
                with open(REGDIR / f"logit_first2role_{y}_summary.txt","w") as f:
                    f.write(m.summary2().as_text())
            except Exception:
                pass

print("[8] First-third behaviors → roles (logit)")
run_first_to_role_models()

In [2]:
# ================================================================
# BEHAVIORAL DELTAS → ROLES (logit)
#   - Δ_mid  = middle - first
#   - Δ_end  = last   - middle
# Predictors: all feature deltas + speaking deltas (+ C(conference) if in PERSON_KEYS)
# Outcomes : role_facilitator (1/0), any_team (1/0), any_funded (1/0)
# Outputs  : CSVs + forest plots (odds ratios ±95% CI)
# ================================================================

# ---------- LOAD DATA IF NEEDED ----------
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from typing import List, Tuple
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=FutureWarning)

# Define base + load long-format file (only if df missing)
if 'df' not in globals():
    BASE = Path("/Users/maxchalekson/Projects/NICO-Research/NICO_human-gemini/facilitator-identification/3-reconsolidating-features-temporal")
    FEAT = BASE / "ALL_person_year_segment_CONSOLIDATED_WITH_OUTCOMES.csv"
    df = pd.read_csv(FEAT)
    df = df[df["segment"].isin(["first","middle","last"])].copy()
    df["segment"] = pd.Categorical(df["segment"], categories=["first","middle","last"], ordered=True)
    if "conference" in df.columns:
        df["conference"] = df["conference"].astype(str)
    print("✅ Loaded df with shape:", df.shape)

# ---------- Expected globals with safe fallbacks ----------
assert 'df' in globals(), "Please load your long data into `df` first."

# REG_FEATURES fallback
if 'REG_FEATURES' not in globals():
    REG_FEATURES = [
        "ann_knowledge_sharing_score",
        "ann_evaluation_practices_score",
        "ann_idea_management_score",
        "ann_coordination_and_decision_practices_score",
        "ann_information_seeking_score",
        "ann_relational_climate_score",
        "ann_participation_dynamics_score",
        "ann_integration_practices_score",
    ]

# Aliases fallback
if 'ALIASES' not in globals():
    ALIASES = {
        "ann_knowledge_sharing": "Knowledge sharing",
        "ann_evaluation_practices": "Evaluation practices",
        "ann_idea_management": "Idea management",
        "ann_coordination_and_decision_practices": "Coordination & decision",
        "ann_information_seeking": "Information seeking",
        "ann_relational_climate": "Relational climate",
        "ann_participation_dynamics": "Participation dynamics",
        "ann_integration_practices": "Integration practices",
        "ann_none": "None",
    }

# PERSON_KEYS fallback
if 'PERSON_KEYS' not in globals():
    PERSON_KEYS = ["person_id" if "person_id" in df.columns else "person_name", "conference", "year"]

# Output dirs
if 'FIGDIR' not in globals():
    FIGDIR = Path("./figures"); FIGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
if 'REGDIR' not in globals():
    REGDIR = Path("./regression-model-output"); REGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# ---------- Build wide ----------
if 'to_wide' not in globals():
    def to_wide(dfin: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        cols = REG_FEATURES + ["p_speaking_duration_sec"]
        blocks = []
        for col in cols:
            pt = dfin.pivot_table(index=PERSON_KEYS, columns="segment",
                                  values=col, aggfunc="sum", observed=False)
            pt.columns = [f"{col}_{c}" for c in pt.columns]
            blocks.append(pt)
        wide_ = pd.concat(blocks, axis=1).reset_index()

        # speaking per segment for deltas
        for seg in ["first","middle","last"]:
            c = f"p_speaking_duration_sec_{seg}"
            if c not in wide_.columns:
                wide_[c] = 0.0

        # role flags
        if "role_facilitator" in dfin.columns:
            rf = dfin.groupby(PERSON_KEYS, as_index=False)["role_facilitator"].max()
            wide_ = wide_.merge(rf, on=PERSON_KEYS, how="left")
            wide_["role_facilitator"] = pd.to_numeric(wide_["role_facilitator"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)

        for flag, col in [("any_team","num_teams"), ("any_funded","num_funded_teams")]:
            if col in dfin.columns:
                tmp = dfin.groupby(PERSON_KEYS, as_index=False)[col].sum()
                tmp[flag] = (tmp[col] > 0).astype(int)
                wide_ = wide_.merge(tmp[PERSON_KEYS + [flag]], on=PERSON_KEYS, how="left")
            else:
                wide_[flag] = 0

        return wide_

if 'wide' not in globals():
    wide = to_wide(df)

# ---------- Make deltas ----------
def _delta_name(base: str, which: str) -> str:
    return f"{base}_d{which}"

def _base_from_feature_col(f: str) -> str:
    return f.replace("_score","")

def make_deltas(w: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = w.copy()
    # speaking deltas
    out["speaking_dmid"] = out["p_speaking_duration_sec_middle"] - out["p_speaking_duration_sec_first"]
    out["speaking_dend"] = out["p_speaking_duration_sec_last"]   - out["p_speaking_duration_sec_middle"]

    for f in REG_FEATURES:
        c_first, c_middle, c_last = f"{f}_first", f"{f}_middle", f"{f}_last"
        if all(c in w.columns for c in [c_first, c_middle, c_last]):
            out[_delta_name(f,"mid")] = w[c_middle].fillna(0) - w[c_first].fillna(0)
            out[_delta_name(f,"end")] = w[c_last].fillna(0)   - w[c_middle].fillna(0)
        else:
            out[_delta_name(f,"mid")] = 0.0
            out[_delta_name(f,"end")] = 0.0
    return out

wide_delta = make_deltas(wide)

# ---------- Helpers ----------
def _has_conference_fe() -> bool:
    return "conference" in PERSON_KEYS

def _delta_cols(which: str) -> List[str]:
    return [_delta_name(f, which) for f in REG_FEATURES]

def _nice_delta_label(term: str) -> str:
    if term == "speaking_dmid": return "Speaking time (Δ middle)"
    if term == "speaking_dend": return "Speaking time (Δ end)"
    if term.endswith("_dmid") or term.endswith("_dend"):
        base = term.replace("_score","").replace("_dmid","").replace("_dend","").replace("ann_","")
        human = ALIASES.get("ann_" + base, base.replace("_"," ").title())
        tail = "Δ middle" if term.endswith("_dmid") else "Δ last"
        return f"{human} ({tail})"
    return term

def _fit_delta_logit(dfR: pd.DataFrame, outcome: str, which: str) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, object]:
    preds = [c for c in _delta_cols(which) if c in dfR.columns]
    if len(preds) == 0 or outcome not in dfR.columns:
        print(f"[delta-{which}] Skipping {outcome}: predictors/outcome missing.")
        return pd.DataFrame(), None

    rhs_terms = preds + ([f"speaking_d{which}"] if f"speaking_d{which}" in dfR.columns else [])
    rhs = " + ".join(rhs_terms)
    if _has_conference_fe():
        rhs += " + C(conference)"

    fml = f"{outcome} ~ {rhs}"
    m = smf.logit(fml, data=dfR).fit(disp=0, maxiter=200)

    tab = pd.DataFrame({
        "term": m.params.index,
        "coef": m.params.values,
        "se":   m.bse.values,
        "p":    m.pvalues.values
    })
    tab["or"]   = np.exp(tab["coef"])
    tab["lo95"] = np.exp(tab["coef"] - 1.96*tab["se"])
    tab["hi95"] = np.exp(tab["coef"] + 1.96*tab["se"])
    tab["which_delta"] = which
    return tab, m

def _plot_delta_forest(tab: pd.DataFrame, outcome: str, which: str):
    keep = tab["term"].str.contains("_dmid|_dend") | tab["term"].isin([f"speaking_d{which}"])
    take = tab[keep].copy()
    if take.empty: 
        print(f"[delta-{which}] No rows to plot for {outcome}."); 
        return

    take = take.sort_values("coef", key=lambda s: s.abs(), ascending=False).head(12)
    take = take.sort_values("or")

    y = np.arange(len(take))
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 6))
    ax.errorbar(take["or"], y,
                xerr=[take["or"] - take["lo95"], take["hi95"] - take["or"]],
                fmt="o", capsize=3)
    ax.axvline(1.0, color="black", lw=1)
    ax.set_yticks(y)
    ax.set_yticklabels([_nice_delta_label(t) for t in take["term"]])
    title_map = {"role_facilitator":"Facilitator (1/0)", "any_team":"Any team (1/0)", "any_funded":"Any funded (1/0)"}
    ax.set_xlabel("Odds ratio (delta predictors, ±95% CI)")
    ax.set_title(f"Behavioral change ({'middle−first' if which=='mid' else 'last−middle'}) → {title_map.get(outcome,outcome)}")
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(FIGDIR / f"logit_delta_{which}_{outcome}.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)

# ---------- Runner ----------
def run_delta_role_models():
    dfR = wide_delta.copy()
    for y in ["role_facilitator","any_team","any_funded"]:
        if y in dfR.columns:
            dfR[y] = pd.to_numeric(dfR[y], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)

    outcomes = [y for y in ["role_facilitator","any_team","any_funded"] if y in dfR.columns]

    for which in ["mid","end"]:
        for y in outcomes:
            print(f"[Δ{which}] Logistic for {y} ...")
            tab, m = _fit_delta_logit(dfR, y, which)
            if tab is None or tab.empty: 
                continue
            tab.to_csv(REGDIR / f"logit_delta_{which}_{y}.csv", index=False)
            try:
                with open(REGDIR / f"logit_delta_{which}_{y}_summary.txt","w") as f:
                    f.write(m.summary2().as_text())
            except Exception:
                pass
            _plot_delta_forest(tab, y, which)

# ---- Call it ----
print("[10] Behavioral deltas → roles (logit)")
run_delta_role_models()

# ================================================================
# COMBINED TRANSITION PANELS (one PNG per feature × group)
# Panels (left→right):  first→middle | middle→last | implied first→last (= T_fm @ T_ml)
# Each is a 3×3 Low/Mid/High row-stochastic matrix (rows sum to 1.0)
# Files saved as:  tmatrix_combo_{group}_{featurecore}.png  in FIGDIR
# ================================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from pathlib import Path

# ------------------- Safe fallbacks / assumptions -------------------
try:
    df  # your long data
except NameError:
    raise AssertionError("Please define `df` (long data with segment ∈ {first,middle,last}).")

if 'REG_FEATURES' not in globals():
    REG_FEATURES = [
        "ann_knowledge_sharing_score",
        "ann_evaluation_practices_score",
        "ann_idea_management_score",
        "ann_coordination_and_decision_practices_score",
        "ann_information_seeking_score",
        "ann_relational_climate_score",
        "ann_participation_dynamics_score",
        "ann_integration_practices_score",
    ]

if 'ALIASES' not in globals():
    ALIASES = {
        "ann_knowledge_sharing": "Knowledge sharing",
        "ann_evaluation_practices": "Evaluation practices",
        "ann_idea_management": "Idea management",
        "ann_coordination_and_decision_practices": "Coordination & decision",
        "ann_information_seeking": "Information seeking",
        "ann_relational_climate": "Relational climate",
        "ann_participation_dynamics": "Participation dynamics",
        "ann_integration_practices": "Integration practices",
        "ann_none": "None",
    }

if 'PERSON_KEYS' not in globals():
    PERSON_KEYS = ["person_id" if "person_id" in df.columns else "person_name", "conference", "year"]

if 'FIGDIR' not in globals():
    FIGDIR = Path("./figures")
FIGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Ensure segment filter + category
df = df[df["segment"].isin(["first","middle","last"])].copy()
df["segment"] = pd.Categorical(df["segment"], ["first","middle","last"], ordered=True)
if "conference" in df.columns:
    df["conference"] = df["conference"].astype(str)

# Build / reuse wide
if 'to_wide' not in globals():
    def to_wide(dfin: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        blocks = []
        for col in REG_FEATURES:
            pt = dfin.pivot_table(index=PERSON_KEYS, columns="segment", values=col, aggfunc="sum")
            pt.columns = [f"{col}_{c}" for c in pt.columns]
            blocks.append(pt)
        wide_ = pd.concat(blocks, axis=1).reset_index()

        # speaking per segment (optional)
        if "p_speaking_duration_sec" in dfin.columns:
            sp = dfin.pivot_table(index=PERSON_KEYS, columns="segment",
                                  values="p_speaking_duration_sec", aggfunc="sum")
            sp.columns = [f"p_speaking_duration_sec_{c}" for c in sp.columns]
            wide_ = wide_.merge(sp, on=PERSON_KEYS, how="left")
        else:
            for c in ["first","middle","last"]:
                wide_[f"p_speaking_duration_sec_{c}"] = 0.0

        # group flags if present
        if "role_facilitator" in dfin.columns:
            rf = dfin.groupby(PERSON_KEYS, as_index=False)["role_facilitator"].max()
            wide_ = wide_.merge(rf, on=PERSON_KEYS, how="left")
            wide_["role_facilitator"] = pd.to_numeric(wide_["role_facilitator"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)

        for flag, col in [("any_team","num_teams"), ("any_funded","num_funded_teams")]:
            if col in dfin.columns:
                tmp = dfin.groupby(PERSON_KEYS, as_index=False)[col].sum()
                tmp[flag] = (tmp[col] > 0).astype(int)
                wide_ = wide_.merge(tmp[PERSON_KEYS + [flag]], on=PERSON_KEYS, how="left")
            else:
                wide_[flag] = 0
        return wide_

try:
    wide  # type: ignore
except NameError:
    wide = to_wide(df)

# ------------------- Helpers -------------------
def _nice_feature_name(f: str) -> str:
    base = f.replace("_score","").replace("ann_","")
    return ALIASES.get("ann_" + base, base.replace("_"," ").title())

def _robust_tertiles(x: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    x = pd.to_numeric(x, errors="coerce")
    if x.notna().sum() == 0:
        return pd.Series(pd.Categorical(["mid"]*len(x), categories=["low","mid","high"]), index=x.index)

    uniq = np.unique(x.dropna())
    if len(uniq) < 3:
        r = x.rank(method="average", pct=True)
        return pd.cut(r, bins=[-0.001, 1/3, 2/3, 1.001], labels=["low","mid","high"])

    try:
        return pd.qcut(x, q=3, labels=["low","mid","high"])
    except Exception:
        std = x.std()
        jitter = (std if std > 0 else 1e-6) * 1e-6
        xr = x + np.random.default_rng(0).normal(0, jitter, size=len(x))
        return pd.qcut(xr, q=3, labels=["low","mid","high"])

def _role_masks(w: pd.DataFrame):
    masks = {"all": pd.Series(True, index=w.index)}
    if "role_facilitator" in w.columns:
        masks["facilitator"] = (w["role_facilitator"] == 1)
    if "any_team" in w.columns:
        masks["any_team"] = (w["any_team"] == 1)
    if "any_funded" in w.columns:
        masks["any_funded"] = (w["any_funded"] == 1)
    return masks

def _cat_cols_for_feature(w: pd.DataFrame, feature: str):
    cols = {}
    for seg in ["first","middle","last"]:
        raw = f"{feature}_{seg}"
        if raw not in w.columns:
            w[raw] = 0.0
        cols[seg] = _robust_tertiles(w[raw])
    return cols  # dict: seg -> categorical series (low/mid/high)

def _transition_tbl(cats_src: pd.Series, cats_dst: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    tbl = pd.crosstab(cats_src, cats_dst, normalize="index").reindex(
        index=["low","mid","high"], columns=["low","mid","high"]
    )
    return tbl.fillna(0.0)

def _plot_combo(feature_name: str, group_name: str, T_fm: pd.DataFrame, T_ml: pd.DataFrame, T_fl: pd.DataFrame, outpath: Path):
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15.6, 5.0), constrained_layout=True)
    for ax, T, title in zip(
        axes,
        [T_fm, T_ml, T_fl],
        ["first → middle", "middle → last", "implied first → last"]
    ):
        sns.heatmap(T, annot=True, fmt=".2f", cmap="Blues", vmin=0, vmax=1,
                    cbar=False, linewidths=.5, linecolor="white", ax=ax,
                    annot_kws={"fontsize":10})
        ax.set_xlabel("To state"); ax.set_ylabel("From state")
        ax.set_title(title)

    fig.suptitle(f"Transition matrices — {feature_name} — {group_name}", fontsize=14, y=1.02)
    fig.savefig(outpath, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)

# ------------------- Main -------------------
def make_transition_panels_combined(features=None):
    feats = features if features is not None else REG_FEATURES
    masks = _role_masks(wide)

    for f in feats:
        feat_nice = _nice_feature_name(f)
        fname_core = feat_nice.lower().replace(" & ", "_").replace(" ", "_")
        # Categorize per segment (on the full sample once, then mask subsets)
        cat_dict = _cat_cols_for_feature(wide, f)  # {'first':..., 'middle':..., 'last':...}

        for gname, gmask in masks.items():
            idx = gmask[gmask].index
            if len(idx) == 0:
                continue

            c_first  = cat_dict["first"].loc[idx]
            c_middle = cat_dict["middle"].loc[idx]
            c_last   = cat_dict["last"].loc[idx]

            # Build 3×3 transitions
            T_fm = _transition_tbl(c_first, c_middle)   # first → middle
            T_ml = _transition_tbl(c_middle, c_last)    # middle → last

            # Implied first → last (Markov composition): T_fl = T_fm @ T_ml
            # Cast to numpy for clean matmul, then back to DataFrame with same labels
            T_fl_np = T_fm.values @ T_ml.values
            T_fl = pd.DataFrame(T_fl_np, index=T_fm.index, columns=T_ml.columns)

            out = FIGDIR / f"tmatrix_combo_{gname}_{fname_core}.png"
            _plot_combo(feat_nice, gname, T_fm, T_ml, T_fl, out)

# ------------------- Call -------------------
print("[T*] Building combined transition panels (first→middle | middle→last | implied first→last)")
make_transition_panels_combined()
print("[T*] Done. See combined PNGs in:", FIGDIR)

combining into one png file¶

In [5]:
# ================================================================
# Combine all transition-matrix PNGs into a single grid image
# ================================================================

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
import math
from pathlib import Path

FIGDIR = Path("./figures")  # adjust if different
OUTFILE = FIGDIR / "tmatrix_all_combined.png"

# --- Gather all PNGs that match your transition naming pattern ---
pngs = sorted(FIGDIR.glob("tmatrix_combo_*.png"))

if not pngs:
    raise FileNotFoundError("No transition PNGs found. Run make_transition_panels_combined() first.")

# --- Load all images ---
imgs = [Image.open(p).convert("RGB") for p in pngs]

# --- Resize to uniform size (based on first image) ---
base_w, base_h = imgs[0].size
imgs = [img.resize((base_w, base_h)) for img in imgs]

# --- Define grid layout ---
cols = 3   # number of images per row (adjust as you like)
rows = math.ceil(len(imgs) / cols)

# --- Create composite canvas ---
gap = 20  # pixel gap between images
canvas_w = cols * base_w + (cols + 1) * gap
canvas_h = rows * base_h + (rows + 1) * gap
combined = Image.new("RGB", (canvas_w, canvas_h), color=(255, 255, 255))

# --- Paste images into grid ---
for i, img in enumerate(imgs):
    r, c = divmod(i, cols)
    x = gap + c * (base_w + gap)
    y = gap + r * (base_h + gap)
    combined.paste(img, (x, y))

# --- Save combined image ---
combined.save(OUTFILE)
print(f"✅ Combined transition image saved to: {OUTFILE}")
print(f"Included {len(imgs)} images in a {rows}×{cols} grid.")

✅ Combined transition image saved to: figures/tmatrix_all_combined.png
Included 32 images in a 11×3 grid.

# ================================================================
# MEGA TRANSITION MATRIX (person-level, temporal thirds)
# - Robust terciles via rank percentiles (handles all-zeros safely)
# - Aligns each person across segments; computes P(state_t+1 | state_t)
# - Groups: All, Facilitator/Non-, AnyTeam/NoTeam, AnyFunded/NoFunded (if present)
# - Saves one combined PNG: figures/mega_transition_matrix.png
# ================================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Tuple

# ---------- INPUTS / FALLBACKS ----------
assert 'df' in globals(), "Please define `df` (long table) before running this cell."

# Ensure segment is ordered
df = df[df['segment'].isin(['first','middle','last'])].copy()
df['segment'] = pd.Categorical(df['segment'], categories=['first','middle','last'], ordered=True)

# Figure dir (fallback)
if 'FIGDIR' not in globals():
    FIGDIR = Path('./figures')
FIGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
OUTFILE = FIGDIR / 'mega_transition_matrix.png'

# If you already have REG_FEATURES, we’ll prefer their *_count versions for descriptives
if 'REG_FEATURES' in globals():
    _counts = [f.replace('_score','_count') for f in REG_FEATURES]
    FEATURES = [c for c in _counts if c in df.columns]
    if not FEATURES:
        FEATURES = [f for f in REG_FEATURES if f in df.columns]
else:
    # autodetect ann_* features (score or count)
    cand = [c for c in df.columns if c.startswith('ann_') and (c.endswith('_score') or c.endswith('_count'))]
    # keep a stable order
    FEATURES = sorted(list(dict.fromkeys(cand)))

# Pretty names
if 'ALIASES' not in globals():
    ALIASES = {
        "ann_knowledge_sharing": "Knowledge sharing",
        "ann_evaluation_practices": "Evaluation practices",
        "ann_idea_management": "Idea management",
        "ann_coordination_and_decision_practices": "Coordination & decision",
        "ann_information_seeking": "Information seeking",
        "ann_relational_climate": "Relational climate",
        "ann_participation_dynamics": "Participation dynamics",
        "ann_integration_practices": "Integration practices",
    }

def nice_feature(col: str) -> str:
    base = col.replace('ann_','').replace('_score','').replace('_count','')
    return ALIASES.get('ann_'+base, base.replace('_',' ').title())

# Keys to align the same person across segments
if 'PERSON_KEYS' in globals():
    PERSON_KEYS = [k for k in PERSON_KEYS if k in df.columns]
else:
    PERSON_KEYS = []
    PERSON_KEYS.append('person_id' if 'person_id' in df.columns else 'person_name')
    for k in ['conference','year']:
        if k in df.columns:
            PERSON_KEYS.append(k)

# ---------- TERCILES (robust via rank percentiles) ----------
STATES = ["Low","Mid","High"]

def tercile_states_rank(x: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """Rank-based terciles: never fails on flat/zero series."""
    x_num = pd.to_numeric(x, errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
    r = x_num.rank(method="average", pct=True)  # in [0,1]
    lab = pd.cut(r, [0.0, 1/3, 2/3, 1.0], labels=STATES, include_lowest=True, right=True)
    return lab.astype(str).fillna("Low")

def build_state_df(df_long: pd.DataFrame, features: List[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Create *_state (Low/Mid/High) columns per feature×segment using rank-terciles."""
    take = df_long.copy()
    take = take[take['segment'].isin(['first','middle','last'])].copy()
    take['segment'] = pd.Categorical(take['segment'], categories=['first','middle','last'], ordered=True)

    keep_keys = [c for c in (PERSON_KEYS + ['segment']) if c in take.columns]
    out = take[keep_keys].copy()

    for f in features:
        if f not in take.columns:
            continue
        out[f + '_state'] = (
            take.groupby('segment', observed=True)[f]
                .transform(tercile_states_rank)
                .astype(str)
                .fillna("Low")
        )

    # carry group flags if present
    for flag in ['role_facilitator','any_team','any_funded']:
        if flag in take.columns:
            out[flag] = take[flag].values

    return out

# ---------- TRANSITIONS ----------
def cross_transition(S: pd.DataFrame, feature: str, start_seg: str, end_seg: str, row_mask=None) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, int]:
    """P(state_end | state_start) with proper person alignment."""
    if row_mask is not None:
        S = S[row_mask].copy()
    cols_needed = [feature + '_state', 'segment'] + [k for k in PERSON_KEYS]
    miss = [c for c in cols_needed if c not in S.columns]
    if miss:
        return pd.DataFrame(np.zeros((3,3)), index=STATES, columns=STATES), 0

    # Pivot person×segment → feature_state
    idx_keys = PERSON_KEYS
    wide = S.pivot_table(index=idx_keys, columns='segment', values=feature + '_state', aggfunc='first')
    if start_seg not in wide.columns or end_seg not in wide.columns:
        return pd.DataFrame(np.zeros((3,3)), index=STATES, columns=STATES), 0

    a = wide[start_seg]
    b = wide[end_seg]
    valid = a.notna() & b.notna()
    N = int(valid.sum())
    if N == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame(np.zeros((3,3)), index=STATES, columns=STATES), 0

    ct = pd.crosstab(a[valid], b[valid], dropna=False)
    ct = ct.reindex(index=STATES, columns=STATES, fill_value=0)
    prob = ct.div(ct.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan), axis=0).fillna(0)
    return prob, N

# ---------- MAIN PLOT ----------
def plot_mega_transition(df_long: pd.DataFrame, features: List[str]=None, max_features: int=8, outfile=OUTFILE):
    """
    Renders a grid: rows=features, columns = [first→middle, middle→last] × groups.
      Groups shown if available: All, Facilitator/Non-, AnyTeam/NoTeam, AnyFunded/NoFunded.
    Each cell is a 3×3 heatmap of P(next_state | current_state) with N in the title.
    """
    feats = [f for f in (features or FEATURES) if f in df_long.columns]
    if max_features and len(feats) > max_features:
        feats = feats[:max_features]

    S = build_state_df(df_long, feats)

    # define groups present in data
    groups = [('All', np.ones(len(S), dtype=bool))]
    if 'role_facilitator' in S.columns:
        groups += [('Facilitator=1', S['role_facilitator'].astype(int)==1),
                   ('Facilitator=0', S['role_facilitator'].astype(int)==0)]
    if 'any_team' in S.columns:
        groups += [('Any team=1', S['any_team'].astype(int)==1),
                   ('Any team=0', S['any_team'].astype(int)==0)]
    if 'any_funded' in S.columns:
        groups += [('Any funded=1', S['any_funded'].astype(int)==1),
                   ('Any funded=0', S['any_funded'].astype(int)==0)]

    transitions = [('first','middle','F→M'), ('middle','last','M→L')]

    n_rows = len(feats)
    n_cols = len(groups) * len(transitions)

    # sizing: keep compact but readable
    cell_w, cell_h = 1.9, 1.9
    fig_w = max(8, cell_w * n_cols + 1.0)
    fig_h = max(6, cell_h * n_rows + 1.5)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(n_rows, n_cols, figsize=(fig_w, fig_h), squeeze=False)
    cmap = 'Blues'

    for i, f in enumerate(feats):
        for jg, (gname, gmask) in enumerate(groups):
            for jt, (s1, s2, tag) in enumerate(transitions):
                j = jg*len(transitions) + jt
                ax = axes[i, j]
                mat, N = cross_transition(S, f, s1, s2, row_mask=gmask)
                sns.heatmap(mat, ax=ax, cmap=cmap, vmin=0, vmax=1, cbar=False,
                            annot=True, fmt=".2f", linewidths=0.5, linecolor='white',
                            annot_kws={'fontsize':8})
                if i == 0:
                    ax.set_title(f"{tag} • {gname}\nN={N}", fontsize=9)
                else:
                    ax.set_title(f"N={N}", fontsize=8)
                ax.set_xlabel('Next state'); ax.set_ylabel('Current state')
                ax.set_xticklabels(STATES, rotation=0, fontsize=8)
                ax.set_yticklabels(STATES, rotation=0, fontsize=8)

        # row label on the left margin
        axes[i,0].text(-0.8, 1.15, nice_feature(f), fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
                       transform=axes[i,0].transAxes, ha='left', va='center')

    fig.suptitle("Within-person behavior transitions: P(next tercile | current tercile)", y=1.02, fontsize=13)
    plt.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(outfile, dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f"[mega-transition] saved -> {outfile}")

# ---------- RUN ----------
plot_mega_transition(df, max_features=8)   # increase/decrease max_features as needed

# ================================================================
# TRAJECTORY CLUSTERING — FIXED OUTPUT PATH SETUP
# ================================================================
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

# ---------- 1. Define stable base path ----------
BASE = Path("/Users/maxchalekson/Projects/NICO-Research/NICO_human-gemini/facilitator-identification/3-reconsolidating-features-temporal")

# define absolute folders
FIGDIR = BASE / "figures"
REGDIR = BASE / "regression-model-output"

# create folders if they don't exist
FIGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
REGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

print("✅ Output directories ready:")
print("FIGDIR:", FIGDIR.resolve())
print("REGDIR:", REGDIR.resolve())

# quick write test
(FIGDIR / "_write_test.txt").write_text("ok")
assert (FIGDIR / "_write_test.txt").exists(), "Could not write to FIGDIR!"


# ================================================================
# TRAJECTORY CLUSTERING FUNCTION
# ================================================================
def run_trajectory_clustering(k=3):
    """
    Cluster people by their temporal feature trajectories across thirds (first, middle, last).
    Creates a trajectory_clusters.png figure and saves cluster assignments CSV.
    """
    global df  # assumes df already loaded (long-form)
    
    # make sure segment ordering is correct
    df["segment"] = pd.Categorical(df["segment"], categories=["first", "middle", "last"], ordered=True)

    # aggregate to person × segment
    PERSON_KEYS = ["person_id" if "person_id" in df.columns else "person_name"]
    feats = [
        "ann_knowledge_sharing_score",
        "ann_evaluation_practices_score",
        "ann_idea_management_score",
        "ann_coordination_and_decision_practices_score",
        "ann_information_seeking_score",
        "ann_relational_climate_score",
        "ann_participation_dynamics_score",
        "ann_integration_practices_score",
    ]

    # pivot: wide table (person × [feature_segment])
    blocks = []
    for f in feats:
        pt = df.pivot_table(index=PERSON_KEYS, columns="segment", values=f, aggfunc="mean").fillna(0)
        pt.columns = [f"{f}_{c}" for c in pt.columns]
        blocks.append(pt)
    wide = pd.concat(blocks, axis=1).reset_index()

    # standardize and cluster
    X = wide.drop(columns=PERSON_KEYS)
    X_scaled = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)
    km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42)
    wide["traj_cluster"] = km.fit_predict(X_scaled)

    # compute cluster-mean trajectories
    cluster_means = []
    for f in feats:
        cluster_mean = (
            wide.groupby("traj_cluster")[[f"{f}_first", f"{f}_middle", f"{f}_last"]]
            .mean()
            .reset_index()
        )
        cluster_mean["feature"] = f
        cluster_means.append(cluster_mean)
    cluster_means = pd.concat(cluster_means, ignore_index=True)

    # ---- Plot ----
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
    for cid, grp in cluster_means.groupby("traj_cluster"):
        for f in feats:
            sub = grp[grp["feature"] == f]
            if not sub.empty:
                ax.plot(
                    ["first", "middle", "last"],
                    sub[[f"{f}_first", f"{f}_middle", f"{f}_last"]].mean().values,
                    marker="o", label=f"Cluster {cid}" if f == feats[0] else "",
                    alpha=0.5,
                )
    ax.set_xlabel("Temporal third")
    ax.set_ylabel("Feature mean (standardized)")
    ax.set_title("Trajectory clusters (average paths across temporal thirds)")
    ax.legend(title="Cluster", loc="center left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.5), frameon=False)
    fig.tight_layout()

    # ---- Save outputs ----
    fig.savefig(FIGDIR / "trajectory_clusters.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)
    wide[PERSON_KEYS + ["traj_cluster"]].to_csv(REGDIR / "trajectory_clusters_assignments.csv", index=False)

    print(f"[T1] ✅ trajectory clustering saved → {FIGDIR / 'trajectory_clusters.png'}")
    print(f"[T1] ✅ cluster assignments saved → {REGDIR / 'trajectory_clusters_assignments.csv'}")


# ---------- Run ----------
print("[T1] trajectory clustering …")
run_trajectory_clustering(k=3)

# ================================================================
# TEMPORAL INTERACTION NETWORKS (person-level)
#   - Pseudo meeting id = conference + year
#   - Edge if two people are co-active on any feature (top tercile)
#   - Compute network metrics per meeting×segment + person×segment
#   - Deltas (middle-first, last-middle) and simple logit links to roles
# Outputs:
#   <BASE>/figures/network_*.png
#   <BASE>/regression-model-output/network_*.csv
# ================================================================

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import networkx as nx
from pathlib import Path
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# ---------- EXPECTED INPUT ----------
# df: long table with columns shown in your printout
assert "df" in globals(), "Load your long dataframe into `df` first."

# ---------- PATHS ----------
BASE   = Path("/Users/maxchalekson/Projects/NICO-Research/NICO_human-gemini/facilitator-identification/3-reconsolidating-features-temporal")
FIGDIR = BASE / "figures"; FIGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
REGDIR = BASE / "regression-model-output"; REGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# ---------- CONFIG ----------
REG_FEATURES = [
    "ann_knowledge_sharing_score",
    "ann_evaluation_practices_score",
    "ann_idea_management_score",
    "ann_coordination_and_decision_practices_score",
    "ann_information_seeking_score",
    "ann_relational_climate_score",
    "ann_participation_dynamics_score",
    "ann_integration_practices_score",
]

PERSON_COL = "person_name" if "person_name" in df.columns else "person_id"

# Build a pseudo meeting id if you don't have meeting/session ids
df = df.copy()
df["conference"] = df["conference"].astype(str)
df["year"] = pd.to_numeric(df["year"], errors="coerce").fillna(-1).astype(int).astype(str)
df["conference_year"] = df["conference"] + "_" + df["year"]
MEET_COL = "conference_year"

# Roles / outcomes
df["any_team"]   = (pd.to_numeric(df.get("num_teams",0), errors="coerce").fillna(0) > 0).astype(int)
df["any_funded"] = (pd.to_numeric(df.get("num_funded_teams",0), errors="coerce").fillna(0) > 0).astype(int)
df["role_facilitator"] = pd.to_numeric(df.get("role_facilitator",0), errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)

# Segment ordering
SEG_ORDER = ["first","middle","last"]
df = df[df["segment"].isin(SEG_ORDER)].copy()
df["segment"] = pd.Categorical(df["segment"], SEG_ORDER, ordered=True)

# ---------- 1) DEFINE ACTIVITY STATES (top tercile within meeting×segment) ----------
def mark_active_by_tercile(dfin: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    d = dfin.copy()

    def _flag_top_tercile(x: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
        # Handle degenerate groups (all equal, usually all zero)
        if x.notna().sum() == 0 or np.nanmax(x) == np.nanmin(x):
            return pd.Series(False, index=x.index)
        q = x.quantile([1/3, 2/3]).values
        hi = q[1]
        # If both terciles collapse (e.g., many zeros), fall back to median split
        if not np.isfinite(hi) or hi == q[0]:
            hi = x.median()
        return x > hi

    for f in REG_FEATURES:
        d[f+"_active"] = (
            d.groupby([MEET_COL, "segment"], observed=True)[f]
             .transform(_flag_top_tercile)
             .astype(bool)
        )
    act_cols = [f"{f}_active" for f in REG_FEATURES]
    d["any_active"] = d[act_cols].any(axis=1)
    return d

dfA = mark_active_by_tercile(df)

# ---------- 2) BUILD GRAPHS PER MEETING×SEGMENT ----------
def build_graph_for_group(block: pd.DataFrame) -> nx.Graph:
    """Edge between two people if they are co-active on ANY feature in this segment; weight=#shared features."""
    people = block[PERSON_COL].unique().tolist()
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(people)

    A = block[[PERSON_COL] + [f"{f}_active" for f in REG_FEATURES]].copy()
    A = A.groupby(PERSON_COL, as_index=True).max()  # dedupe
    if A.shape[0] < 2:
        return G

    active_people = A.index[A.any(axis=1)].tolist()
    for i, p in enumerate(active_people):
        feats_i = A.loc[p].values
        for q in active_people[i+1:]:
            feats_q = A.loc[q].values
            shared = int(np.sum(feats_i & feats_q))
            if shared > 0:
                G.add_edge(p, q, weight=shared)
    return G

def compute_graph_metrics(G: nx.Graph) -> dict:
    n = G.number_of_nodes()
    m = G.number_of_edges()
    dens = nx.density(G) if n > 1 else 0.0
    trans = nx.transitivity(G) if n > 2 else 0.0
    clust = nx.average_clustering(G) if n > 2 else 0.0
    giant = 0
    if n > 0:
        comps = sorted(nx.connected_components(G), key=len, reverse=True)
        giant = len(comps[0]) if comps else 0
    return dict(n=n, m=m, density=dens, transitivity=trans, avg_clustering=clust, giant=giant)

# Meeting×segment metrics
records = []
for (mtg, seg), block in dfA.groupby([MEET_COL, "segment"], observed=True):
    G = build_graph_for_group(block)
    met = compute_graph_metrics(G)
    met.update({MEET_COL: mtg, "segment": seg})
    records.append(met)

net_meeting_seg = pd.DataFrame(records)
net_meeting_seg.to_csv(REGDIR/"network_meeting_segment_metrics.csv", index=False)

# ---------- 3) PERSON×SEGMENT METRICS ----------
node_rows = []
for (mtg, seg), block in dfA.groupby([MEET_COL, "segment"], observed=True):
    G = build_graph_for_group(block)
    if G.number_of_nodes() == 0:
        continue
    deg = dict(G.degree())
    cl  = nx.clustering(G) if G.number_of_nodes()>2 else {n:0.0 for n in G.nodes()}
    bt  = nx.betweenness_centrality(G, normalized=True) if G.number_of_nodes()>2 else {n:0.0 for n in G.nodes()}
    for p in G.nodes():
        node_rows.append({
            MEET_COL: mtg, "segment": seg, PERSON_COL: p,
            "deg": deg.get(p,0), "clustering": cl.get(p,0.0), "betweenness": bt.get(p,0.0)
        })

net_person_seg = pd.DataFrame(node_rows)

# Join roles (max across appearances)
roles = (df[[PERSON_COL,"role_facilitator","any_team","any_funded"]]
         .groupby(PERSON_COL, as_index=False).max())
net_person_seg = net_person_seg.merge(roles, on=PERSON_COL, how="left")
net_person_seg.to_csv(REGDIR/"network_person_segment_metrics.csv", index=False)

# ---------- 4) DELTAS (middle-first, last-middle) per person ----------
def pivot_person_seg(dfin, value):
    p = (dfin.pivot_table(index=PERSON_COL, columns="segment", values=value, aggfunc="mean")
              .reindex(columns=SEG_ORDER))
    return p

metric_list = ["deg","clustering","betweenness"]
delta_rows = []
for met in metric_list:
    W = pivot_person_seg(net_person_seg, met)
    if W.isna().all().all():
        continue
    D_mid = (W["middle"] - W["first"]).fillna(0)
    D_end = (W["last"]   - W["middle"]).fillna(0)
    tmp = pd.DataFrame({
        PERSON_COL: W.index, f"{met}_first": W["first"],
        f"{met}_middle": W["middle"], f"{met}_last": W["last"],
        f"d_mid_{met}": D_mid, f"d_end_{met}": D_end
    })
    delta_rows.append(tmp.set_index(PERSON_COL))
net_person_delta = pd.concat(delta_rows, axis=1).reset_index()
net_person_delta = net_person_delta.merge(roles, on=PERSON_COL, how="left")
net_person_delta.to_csv(REGDIR/"network_person_deltas.csv", index=False)

# ---------- 5) DESCRIPTIVE PLOTS ----------
def line_metric_across_segments(metric="avg_clustering"):
    gp = net_meeting_seg.pivot_table(index=MEET_COL, columns="segment", values=metric, aggfunc="mean")
    means = gp.mean().reindex(SEG_ORDER)
    cis   = gp.apply(lambda s: 1.96*s.std()/np.sqrt(s.notna().sum()), axis=0).reindex(SEG_ORDER)

    x = np.arange(3)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4))
    ax.plot(x, means.values, marker="o")
    ax.fill_between(x, (means-cis).values, (means+cis).values, alpha=0.2)
    ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(SEG_ORDER)
    ax.set_title(f"{metric} (meeting-level)"); ax.set_ylabel(metric)
    fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(FIGDIR/f"network_{metric}_by_segment.png", dpi=300); plt.close(fig)

for m in ["density","transitivity","avg_clustering","giant"]:
    line_metric_across_segments(m)

# Simple role contrasts for person-level clustering (mean bars by segment)
def bars_by_role(metric="clustering"):
    take = net_person_seg[[PERSON_COL,"segment",metric,"role_facilitator","any_team","any_funded"]].copy()
    segs = SEG_ORDER
    x = np.arange(len(segs)); width = 0.35
    for role in ["role_facilitator","any_team","any_funded"]:
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4))
        tmp = (take.groupby(["segment", role])[metric].mean().unstack(role)).reindex(segs)
        ax.bar(x-width/2, tmp[0].values, width, label=f"{role}=0")
        ax.bar(x+width/2, tmp[1].values, width, label=f"{role}=1")
        ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(segs)
        ax.set_title(f"{metric} by segment × {role}")
        ax.legend()
        fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(FIGDIR/f"network_{metric}_by_{role}.png", dpi=300); plt.close(fig)

bars_by_role("clustering")

# ---------- 6) LINK NETWORK CHANGE → OUTCOMES (logit; illustrative) ----------
for outcome in ["any_funded","any_team","role_facilitator"]:
    if outcome not in net_person_delta.columns:
        continue
    cols = [c for c in ["d_mid_clustering","d_end_clustering","clustering_first"] if c in net_person_delta.columns]
    if not cols:
        continue
    fml = f"{outcome} ~ " + " + ".join(cols)
    m = smf.logit(fml, data=net_person_delta.dropna()).fit(disp=0, maxiter=200)
    tab = pd.DataFrame({
        "term": m.params.index, "coef": m.params.values, "se": m.bse.values, "p": m.pvalues.values
    })
    tab["or"]   = np.exp(tab["coef"])
    tab["lo95"] = np.exp(tab["coef"] - 1.96*tab["se"])
    tab["hi95"] = np.exp(tab["coef"] + 1.96*tab["se"])
    tab.to_csv(REGDIR/f"logit_network_change__{outcome}.csv", index=False)
    print(f"[logit] {outcome}\n", tab[["term","or","lo95","hi95","p"]])

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Assume you already have net_person_seg with columns:
# ['person_name', 'segment', 'deg', 'clustering', 'betweenness',
#  'role_facilitator', 'any_team', 'any_funded']

def plot_network_metric_by_role(net_person_seg, metric="clustering"):
    seg_order = ["first","middle","last"]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(12, 4), sharey=True)
    roles = {
        "role_facilitator": "Facilitators",
        "any_team": "On a Team",
        "any_funded": "Funded Teams"
    }

    for ax, (col, title) in zip(axes, roles.items()):
        tmp = (net_person_seg
               .groupby(["segment", col])[metric]
               .mean()
               .reset_index()
               .pivot(index="segment", columns=col, values=metric)
               .reindex(seg_order))
        tmp.plot(kind="line", marker="o", ax=ax)
        ax.set_title(title)
        ax.set_xlabel("Segment")
        ax.set_ylabel(f"Mean {metric}")
        ax.legend(["No", "Yes"], title=title.split()[0])
        ax.grid(alpha=0.3)

    plt.suptitle(f"Network {metric.title()} Over Time by Role", fontsize=14)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(FIGDIR / f"network_{metric}_by_role_temporal.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()

plot_network_metric_by_role(net_person_seg, metric="clustering")
